name: experience-ablation-plan-corrected
title: Author the corrected experience-layer A/B ablation causal-validation execution plan
description: The draft execution plan for the experience-layer A/B ablation causal-validation study was adversarially reviewed on 2026-07-02 (2-round multi-agent review: 4 repo mappers + 4 review lenses + 12 independent adjudicators; 12/12 findings verified as real). The untracked draft file docs/requirements/decisions/experience-layer-ablation-causal-validation-execution-plan.md was deleted from disk mid-review by concurrent repo activity, so nothing remains on disk. This story authors the corrected plan into docs/requirements/decisions/, incorporating all 12 verified corrections: 3 validity holes (answer-key circularity, learning-store pollution, fixture leakage), per-population sample-size recalibration (~6x oversizing fixed), matched-pairs design replacing incoherent 5-factor blocking, reuse of existing infrastructure (hint-mode arm switch, recovery-runner harness, analyze.mjs statistics) instead of greenfield rebuild, a deterministic reviewer-free primary endpoint, artifact-root naming fixes, and endpoint/claim alignment. Docs-only: no code, no gate, no schema changes.
